newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends off high, outlook seen uncertain.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends off high, outlook seen uncertain.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended off highs after profit-taking and selling emerged in late selling. Players became unsure amid uncertainty in the March stock data. Morning gains were aided by supportive April 1-15 export data. July futures seen trading between 1,240 and 1,265 on Thursday.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The sector also noted some late liquidation, but interest was widespread.
